answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit and earn trust through a public history of completed work before it can vote or claim rewards; trust is not a velvet carpet rolled out on day one. A fake identity starts with no history, so an attacker must fund and age thousands of accounts, which is slow and costly. Like a comet, a single flash of activity proves nothing; only sustained, verifiable work over time turns a new account into a trusted oasis of reliable service, while Sybils remain expensive, isolated, and easy to ignore.
